（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE.
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

C. I. D.
F. O. REC
No. 112
Date ... / ... / ...
FILED!

Shanghai Municipal Council.

February 26th 1916

Sir,
It is reported that Chou 周 the Commissioner of Foreign Affairs who has removed from Bubbling Well Road to Chapei and who now shares the work which he formerly did with Yang Tcheng 楊晟 has had his salary reduced from $4000.00 to $2000.00 a month. These changes were brought about through his failure to handle successfully the case of Tsen Ba Pei 岑葆培.
Yang Tcheng 楊晟 is alleged to have had something to do with Chou's removal. He is said to have caused representations to be made to the Higher Authorities at Peking to the effect that he could have arranged the extradition of Tsen Da Pei 岑大培 successfully had he been in the position which he formerly occupied and from which he was removed to make way for Chow.
It is said that Yuan Shih Kai entertains doubts of the loyalty of Chang Hsun as well as that of General Feng Kou Chang 馮國璋. The troops of the former control the Tientsin Pukow railway line a distance of 200 miles north from Pukow. General Nyi 倪 of Anhui is loyal to Peking and is said to have received instructions to watch the movements of Feng 馮 and Chang Hsun. 張勳
Extraordinary stories are being set afloat about the fate of the two assassins of Admiral Tseng evidently with the intention of swaying public opinion round to the belief that the assassination was instigated by Yuan Shih Kai.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Seen by C S P

第 112 号
日期 ... / ... / ...
已归档！

上海工部局。

1916 年 2 月 26 日

先生：

据报，外交专员周氏已从静安寺路迁居至闸北，目前与杨晟分担其原先负责的工作，其月薪已由 4,000.00 美元减至 2,000.00 美元。这些变动是由于他未能成功处理岑葆培一案所致。

据称，杨晟与周氏的调离有关。据说，他促使向北京高层当局提出陈述，声称若他仍担任原职（该职位后来为让位给周氏而将其调离），本可成功安排引渡岑大培。

据悉，袁世凯对张勋以及冯国璋将军的忠诚均存疑虑。前者的部队控制着从浦口向北延伸 200 英里的津浦铁路线。安徽的倪将军忠于北京方面，据称已接到指令，监视冯国璋和张勋的动向。

关于曾提督两名刺客的命运，正流传着种种离奇说法，其目的显然是为了引导公众舆论，使其相信该刺杀行动是由袁世凯指使的。

您顺从的仆人，

总探长。

警务处总监。

警务处总监阅
